table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	Status=0,
	ClientInstanceID=V.ClientInstanceID,
	Client=(SELECT CL.Name FROM CRS_ClientList CL, CRS_ClientInstance CI WHERE CI.ClientInstanceID=V.ClientInstanceID AND CI.ClientID=CL.ClientID),
	code1 = V.AccCode, 
	date1 = V.date, 
	name2 = V.documenttype + '-' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), V.documentcode))), 
	name1 = A.name,		
	name5 = A.aliasname,		
	value1= V.Debit,
	value2= V.Credit,
	name3 = V.Remarks,
	name4 = S.name, 
	CheckNo = V.CheckNo,
	Vrow=V.VRow,
	OpenBalance=
			ISNULL((select isnull(sum(virtualgl.debit - virtualgl.credit), 0) from crs_virtualgl virtualgl
			where	
				(Virtualgl.Clientinstanceid = CASE WHEN :ai_clientinstanceid > 0 THEN :ai_clientinstanceid ELSE Virtualgl.Clientinstanceid END) AND
				(virtualgl.acccode=V.acccode) and 
				virtualgl.date < :startdate), 0),
	vouchercode=V.vouchercode
FROM 
     CRS_VirtualGL V, Accounts A, SubAccounts S
WHERE
	(V.Clientinstanceid = CASE WHEN :ai_clientinstanceid > 0 THEN :ai_clientinstanceid ELSE V.Clientinstanceid END) AND
	V.AccCode IN (:acccode) and
	V.AccCode = A.AccCode AND
	V.Date BETWEEN :startdate and :enddate AND
	A.SubCode = S.SubAccCode
ORDER BY
	name1, name5, status, date, name2, V.VRow

objects.name: compute_14
objects.expression: if( sum(OpenBalance for all distinct account,  openbalance  ) + Sum(  debit  -  credit  for all )  >0,'Dr.', 'Cr.' )

objects.name: compute_13
objects.expression: abs( sum(OpenBalance for all distinct account, openbalance) + Sum(  debit  -  credit  for all ))

objects.name: balance
objects.expression: abs( OpenBalance + cumulativeSum(  debit  -  credit  for group 1 ))

objects.name: compute_8
objects.expression: if( OpenBalance + cumulativeSum(  debit  -  credit  for group 1) >0,'Dr.', 'Cr.' )

objects.name: compute_7
objects.expression: if( OpenBalance + cumulativeSum(  debit  -  credit  for group 1)-debit+credit>0,'Dr.', 'Cr.' )

objects.name: c_openbalance
objects.expression: abs( OpenBalance + cumulativeSum(  debit  -  credit  for group 1 )-debit+credit)

objects.name: compute_9
objects.expression: if( OpenBalance + Sum(  debit  -  credit  for group 1) >0,'Dr.', 'Cr.' )

objects.name: compute_4
objects.expression: abs( OpenBalance + Sum(  debit  -  credit  for group 1 ))
